scope: Sequential local diagnostic compatibility audit, macOS arm64, no concurrent builds or tests. Eight invocations and 36 workload cases per Node major. Assertions validate intended computations; observations are not universal resource limits or performance gates. Each invocation has an external 120-second allowance in addition to any diagnostic child limits.

output.method: One warmup and five timed Explain.report calls per case, using default limits. Construction and assertions excluded. No backend search. Values are powers of ten; exact product digit counts are derived algebraically. Timings include model validation, digesting, assignment capture and arithmetic evaluation. Maximum product length is 262081 digits; this is not a general resource-limit test.

output.timing: complete Explain.report, including cloning, validation and digest; excludes fixture construction and result assertions
output.rss: after workload and assertions; not peak memory or a total-process limit
